title: remote-pi-relay
description: Configuration for the Remote Pi self-hosted relay chart. In addition to the keys defined here, all values of the TrueCharts 'common' chart (service, workload, podOptions, persistence, ...) are accepted - see https://truecharts.org/common/

port.description: TCP port serving WS upgrade, /health, and /mesh/* (same port).

dbPath.description: SQLite path for Owner-signed mesh blobs, e.g. /data/mesh.db.

logLevel.description: RUST_LOG filter, e.g. info, debug, warn. Empty means image default.
